blocks.source: 【RPGレビュー】ファイナルファンタジー8
FF6,7と同じく、世界観はファンタジーとSFの要素が入り交じっている。主人公のスコールはFF7のクラウドに引き続いてクール系。兵士養成学校のガーデンに属する主人公がその任務を果たす中で、物語が進んでいく。
blocks.translation: As in FF6 and FF7, the setting blends elements of fantasy and science fiction. The protagonist, Squall, continues FF7's tradition of cool protagonists with Cloud. The story unfolds as he carries out his duties as a member of Garden, a military academy.

blocks.source: シナリオはやや難解だが、色々と練り込まれており奥は深い。後で見ると「そういう意味だったのか！」となるようなさりげない伏線が多数ある。（例：魔女への狙撃をためらうアーヴァイン。その時点ではタダのヘタレにしか見えないが・・・）
blocks.translation: The scenario is somewhat difficult to understand, but it is intricately crafted and has considerable depth. There are many subtle plot points that make you think, "So that's what it meant!" when you look back on them later. (For example, Irvine hesitates to snipe the sorceress. At that point, he just seems like a complete coward, but...)

blocks.source: 主人公とヒロインが物語の中心になるが、途中で足を引っ張ったり、ベタベタしたりで、ヒロインのリノアを嫌う人が多い模様。また、唐突な展開が１点あるのも、賛否が分かれる。色々と伏線はあるのだが、初見で意味を予測できる人は少ないのが、唐突に感じてしまうのだと思う。
blocks.translation: The protagonist and heroine are at the center of the story, but many people seem to dislike the heroine, Rinoa, because she gets in the way at times and is overly clingy. There is also one abrupt development, which has divided opinion. There are various hints leading up to it, but I think it feels abrupt because few people can predict their meaning on a first playthrough.

blocks.source: ラストダンジョン、ラストバトル、エンディングはかなり力が入っている。クリアした時は達成感があった。
blocks.translation: The final dungeon, final battle, and ending all received considerable attention. Clearing the game was a rewarding experience.

blocks.source: 7までのFFとは、大きくゲームデザインが異なっており、旧スクウェアの看板シリーズとは思えないほどの冒険振りが特徴。斬新過ぎるため、とっつきにくいと感じるかも。
blocks.translation: The game design differs greatly from that of FF games up through FF7, and its daring nature is so pronounced that it hardly seems like one of former Square's flagship series. It is so innovative that you may find it difficult to get into.

blocks.source: その要因として最たるものがレベル連動性。サガシリーズの如く、味方のレベルを上げると、敵のレベルも上がる。レベルを上げてもほとんど味方は強くならないが、敵ははっきりと強くなるので、迂闊にレベルを上げると戦闘で苦戦するようになる可能性も。
blocks.translation: The most significant factor is level scaling. As in the SaGa series, when your party members' levels rise, the enemies' levels rise as well. Raising your level barely makes your party stronger, while enemies become noticeably stronger, so leveling up carelessly may make battles more difficult.

blocks.source: では、どうやって味方を強くするのかというと、魔法を装備する事で行う。装備できる箇所は『HP』『力』『魔力』という様に分かれており「どこに」「何の魔法を」「何個」装備するかによって、ステータスの伸びが変わる。魔法は１種類１００個まで持てるが、使用すると個数が減って装備箇所のステータスも下がるのは困りもの。
blocks.translation: So how do you make your party stronger? By equipping magic. The equippable attributes are divided into categories such as "HP," "Strength," and "Magic," and the way your stats grow depends on "where," "which magic," and "how many" spells you equip. You can hold up to 100 of each type of magic, but using it reduces the number you have and lowers the stats of the attribute where it is equipped, which is troublesome.

blocks.source: 魔法は『ドロー』によって、戦闘中に敵から手に入れる方法があるが、地道な作業になるので面倒臭いと感じるかもしれない。それよりも、アイテムから魔法を精製するアビリティが非常に強力で、１つのアイテムから、数十個の魔法を精製できることもある。これをうまく使えれば、進行がグッと楽になる。
blocks.translation: You can obtain magic from enemies during battle using "Draw," but it involves tedious repetition, so you may find it tiresome. More importantly, the abilities that refine magic from items are extremely powerful, and a single item can sometimes be refined into dozens of spells. Using this effectively makes progressing through the game much easier.

blocks.source: 各キャラクターはGF（Guardian Force：今作の召喚獣）を装備することによって、アビリティを使用できる様になる。GFは戦闘を重ねて成長し、新たなアビリティを習得する。上述した魔法の精製もこれによって使えるようになる。
blocks.translation: Each character can use abilities by equipping a GF (Guardian Force, this game's equivalent of summons). GFs grow through battles and learn new abilities. This is also how you gain access to the magic-refining abilities mentioned above.

blocks.source: FF7のリミット技に代わるものとして、特殊技がある。使用条件はHPが減った状態で、キャラにターンが回ってくること。リスクは大きいのだが、条件を満たしていれば連発も可能なので非常に強力。
blocks.translation: Special Techniques take the place of FF7's Limit Techniques. They can be used when a character's HP is low and their turn comes up. Although they carry considerable risk, they are extremely powerful because they can be used repeatedly as long as the conditions are met.

blocks.source: ミニゲームとしてカードゲームが用意されているのだが、集めたカードをアイテムに変換し、そこから更に魔法を精製することで、パーティを強化することもできる。これによって、戦闘をしないでも、パーティを強化できてしまうのは斬新だ。「エンカウントなし」なんていうアビリティもあって、それを奨励している部分も見られる。
blocks.translation: A card game is available as a minigame, and you can strengthen your party by converting collected cards into items and then refining magic from those items. It is innovative that this allows you to strengthen your party without fighting battles. There is even an ability called "No Encounters," suggesting that the game somewhat encourages this approach.

blocks.source: 以上のシステムにより、普通にザコ戦をして、レベル上げしても、メリットが無い様に思えるが、完全にそうとも言い切れない。敵のレベルが上がると、敵からドローできる魔法や落とすアイテムが強力になっていくからだ。ボス敵に付いては、最高レベルが設定されているため、「敵のレベルが上がり過ぎて詰んだ」という心配もいらない。
blocks.translation: Given these systems, it may seem that fighting ordinary enemies and leveling up provides no benefit, but that is not entirely true. As enemy levels rise, the magic you can Draw from them and the items they drop become more powerful. Boss enemies have a maximum level set for them, so you do not have to worry about getting stuck because the enemies leveled up too much.

blocks.source: 戦闘が開始するまでの時間が十数秒とかなり長い。また、GFは戦闘中に使用すると、敵に大ダメージを与えるなどの強力な効果を持つが、演出は非常に長い。（短いもので１５秒、長いものだと数分に渡る。）GF以外にも強力な攻撃手段は多いので、システムに慣れたなら、使わずに進めた方がストレスが無くて良いかも。
blocks.translation: The wait before battles begin is quite long, taking more than ten seconds. GFs also have powerful effects when used in battle, such as dealing heavy damage to enemies, but their animations are extremely long. (The shortest last 15 seconds, while the longest run for several minutes.) There are many other powerful ways to attack, so once you become familiar with the system, it may be less stressful to proceed without using them.

blocks.source: とはいえ、上述した通り、ザコ戦が面倒なら一切しなくとも良いのがこの作品。ボスに関しても特殊技を使いこなせば瞬殺可能だ。それにより、ストーリーをドンドン進めて行くスタイルもある。
blocks.translation: That said, as mentioned above, this is a game where you can skip ordinary battles entirely if they become tedious. Bosses can also be killed instantly if you make effective use of Special Techniques. This allows you to adopt a playstyle focused on rapidly advancing the story.

blocks.source: FF7と比べると、格段にムービーが美しくなった。召喚獣にあたるGFや特殊技は非常に派手。さすがに、PSの作品は今見ると、ポリゴンが荒く感じられるけれど・・・。
blocks.translation: Compared to FF7, the cutscenes became dramatically more beautiful. The GFs and Special Techniques, which serve as the game's summons, are extremely flashy. Still, now that we are looking back at a PlayStation game, the polygons do feel rather rough...

blocks.source: シリーズお馴染みのイントロから始まるラストバトルはシリーズでも最高レベルだと思う。その他にも飛空艇など名曲が多い。通常ボス戦曲が地味に格好良い。
blocks.translation: I think the final battle, which begins with the series' familiar intro, is among the best in the series. There are also many other excellent tracks, such as the airship theme. The regular boss battle theme is understated yet stylish.

blocks.source: FF8と言えばこのサイト。FF8好きの方が作った考察サイトで、当時、この作品を批判する意見が今よりもずっと多い中で作られた。FF8以外にも、FFやDQシリーズ全般に付いて、造詣が深く、僕も感銘を受けた。「何が嫌いかより、何が好きかで自分を語れよ！」は名言だと思う。2006年から更新が無いのが残念。
blocks.translation: When it comes to FF8, this is the site to visit. It is an analysis site created by an FF8 fan, made at a time when opinions criticizing the game were much more common than they are today. The creator also has extensive knowledge of the FF and DQ series as a whole, not just FF8, and I was deeply impressed. "Don't define yourself by what you hate; define yourself by what you love!" is a memorable quote. It is a shame that the site has not been updated since 2006.
